main_text.p: Ætate consistente, Senectute, ac in multis aliis eadem illa tela texitur: Hinc etiam Elementa quædam Symbola dicuntur, quæ nempe in eadem qualitate prima conveniunt: ut Ignis & Aër in Calore: Aër & Aqua in Humore: Aqua & Terra in Frigore: Terra & Ignis in Siccitate (hæc inter se orbem saltatorium versant) Quædam Assymbola: ut Ignis & Aqua: Aër & Terra (hæc disjuncta tripudiant) His momentis examinant Elementorum aliorum in alia faciles ac difficiles commutationes: in his observantur præterea multa ficta, frivola, ad quæ longum gum

page.notes: The last line "gum" is printed as the word completion of "longum" set on the right of the line. Show-through and fragments of the facing page at the right edge are not transcribed. The word "Ætate" begins a fragment of the previous line; the first line is the page's first full line.
